method.first: Run existing V13 guard_nodes over whole pinned original production; report inapplicable if empty
method.second: Generic posthoc AST relevance: parse source text embedded by protected tests as Python; extract identifier tokens (Name,Attribute,Import,ImportFrom.module), compute rarity weighted overlap with source production function AST identifiers, string identifier tokens and imports; no target-specific location or repair names
method.third: Rank functions by rarity-weighted overlap, prefer functions with at least two protected-source distinct terms; tie by original line then name. Top three functions.
method.fourth: On separately selected original source functions, call byte-pinned unchanged V104 program_candidates with cap=16, then re-embed modified exact function AST in original module while preserving all other ASTs; no native candidate evaluation or program promotion.
method.fifth: Quotient original 37 MSI named policies by identical first-eight-candidate ordered sequences (source-only); verify all alias-order equivalences without altering original Pareto selection science.

negative_controls: all re-embedded unaffected top-level AST equivalent
evaluation.important_distinction: A posthoc source-derived candidate-eligibility diagnosis, not a qualified native repair. If V13 guard_nodes empty, existing V13 observer cannot be claimed activated for this source; generic lexical selector is new human-authored diagnostic.
